_comment: Extra React codebases for the accessibility post only, in the same shape as repos.json. Loaded alongside repos.json when CORPUS_REPO_LISTS=repos-accessibility.json is set (see collect-files.cjs), so repos.json, its SHAs and every earlier topic's numbers don't change. Cloned by a11y-clone.sh (shallow, sparse). Global exclusions (tests, stories, fixtures, examples, vendored dirs, *.d.ts, third-party license headers) come from collect-files.cjs. Chosen to contrast: shadcn/ui is the copy-paste component layer (MIT), Radix Primitives and React Aria Components are accessibility-focused libraries with different designs (MIT; Apache-2.0), and Supabase Studio is a large real-world app built on a shadcn-derived design system (Apache-2.0).
